capabilities: View and manage Microsoft To Do tasks in a sidebar
Quick-capture tasks with a list and due date from commands or hotkeys
Create, delete, and switch between To Do lists
Edit due dates, importance, notes, and checklist steps
Export all lists, tasks, and notes to a Markdown note
extras: Token handling and privacy are documented in detail: refresh tokens go to Obsidian Keychain, data.json keeps no tokens, and there is no telemetry. Manual installation only; requires Obsidian 1.11.5 or later. Checklist step ordering is stored only in the vault because Microsoft Graph does not expose it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see or manage tasks stored in Microsoft To Do, so users must switch apps to check or add tasks.
summary: Sidebar integration that lets you view, create, complete, and edit Microsoft To Do tasks inside Obsidian via Microsoft Graph.
